title: gossypium hirsutum subsp. prostratum
intro: Gossypium hirsutum subsp. prostratum, commonly known as the prostrate cotton, is a subspecies of the cotton plant, native to tropical and subtropical regions of Asia and Australia. The prostrate cotton has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including treating wounds, skin conditions, and inflammation, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include analgesic, anti-oxidative, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. The bioactive constituents of Gossypium hirsutum subsp. prostratum may also exhibit antioxidant and antiseptic properties, making it a potential candidate for the development of new medicinal products.
